I lean toward buying a modest position — the user's mandate is clearly oriented toward deploying capital in AAPL/INTC, and the verified fundamentals (FY2023) show a highly profitable, cash-generative business. A middle path: buy a small position (e.g., 10 shares ≈ $2,227, well under $5,000) rather than maxing out, reflecting limited conviction due to unverified current results. That's a sensible, proportionate action.
